author: Daniel Koh
audience: Engineering only — not yet shared with Product or sponsors
headline: Producer is in SG shadow mode. I will not sign a 28 Aug cutover.
body:
Week 8 note.

Producer path is in shadow mode in SG and matching batch output on ~98% of sampled merchants. That is the good news.

Two gates are not met:
1) Catalog consumer lag under dinner peak is still 4–7 minutes (gate is p95 < 60s for 7 days). MENU-255 is the work. I do not have a dated recovery plan I trust.
2) Historical backfill was kicked off this week. I am treating kickoff as progress, not completion. We should not cut over until backfill has drained and we have done a freshness audit.

Given those gates, 28 Aug is not a responsible cutover date. Earliest date I will sign is Friday 4 Sep 2026, which gives us a week after Priya is back and after backfill drain for soak.

Product still has 28 Aug on the sponsor slide. We need a date decision this week or we will brief directors with two different dates.

MY: I have not reviewed MY readiness in detail. If SG slips, MY 18 Sep is automatically at risk. I have not told Farah to change MENU-305.

I am not covering incident write-ups in this note; ops owns those.

gates.name: sg_backfill_complete
gates.current: job running; % complete not in this note

asks: Director decision: move SG cutover from 28 Aug to 4 Sep, or accept cutover with unmet lag/backfill gates.
Loaned engineer for MENU-255 while Priya is out — not named in this note; see Slack.
